content: Almost all the world takes pleasure in paying small debts; many show gratitude for moderate benefits; but almost everyone is ungrateful for immense ones.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
sourceWork: Memoirs of the Regency of Anne of Austria
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Water is the softest thing on earth, yet it carves through solid granite. It doesn't fight obstacles; it yields, flows around them, and quietly finds its way to its natural level.

François de La Rochefoucauld understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. When we force outcomes with brute willpower and anxiety, we exhaust ourselves and create unnecessary resistance. Aligning with nature means trusting the timing of things and moving with steady, patient persistence.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
